newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Mainfreight buys two haulage companies.
newsitem.headline: Mainfreight buys two haulage companies.

text.p: Mainfreight Ltd said on Monday it had concluded the purchase of Combined Haulage Ltd and Senco Haulage Ltd from its founder shareholders.
The purchase is effective from today, with final settlement this week.
"Combined haulage operates 28 vehicles and is domiciled in Auckland and Wellington, providing local cartage and line haul through the North Island," Mainfreight said.
"Senco Haulage operates eight vehicles and is based in Tauranga, providing local and regional transport services."
Mainfreight said collectively the two businesses had income in excess of NZ$5 million.
The purchase price would be disclosed in the fourth quarter results to March 31, 1997.

"The Combined and Senco operations will add to Mainfreight's branch network and our ability to provide a superior level of freight and distribution coverage throughout the North Island", Mainfreight said.
